name: build
description: From an approved design to an open pull request: a plan of test-first tasks, executed inline or with a fresh subagent per task, a ledger that survives compaction, a review after every task and a whole-branch review at the end. On request, a design sketched as competing candidates and built against the chosen one, several attempts at one task grafted into the best, and an adversarial review by reviewers on different models. For work no narrower skill fits, a phase list designed before the run and kept honest by a decision trail. A performance number vetted before it is reported, and the comments of a change cut to those the code cannot say. A correction is recorded in the mistake ledger, and a mistake that repeats becomes a check.
